milestone: K7 input-independent frame-score and abstention oracle
decision_changed: whether K7 scoring/group-rule fixtures are ready for later template-learning integration
scope: synthetic saved residuals, states, blocks and candidate IDs only; not template learning, matched-filter detection, whitening, threshold calibration or real classification

candidate_union.members: stable union of unit events and held-out stationary-template matched-filter detections
candidate_union.duplicate_id_policy: one row per event ID; conflicting sample/state/block metadata fail closed
candidate_union.selection_prohibition: residuals and labels cannot affect union membership

eligibility.training: at least two states separated by at least 80 um
eligibility.held_out: only states with absolute displacement at least 80 um

score.state_balance: each eligible state contributes one median regardless of event count

labels.thresholds: explicit external calibration inputs; no default and no reuse of C4-2 plus/minus 0.2
labels.operational_default: undetermined remains tissue-fixed without changing its reported label

group_rule.linking_only: unvalidated linked fragments remain separate and are flagged probe_fixed_candidate_group
group_rule.promotion_evidence: member-level per-unit probe-fixed result or independently supplied known-pulse coincidence pass
group_rule.no_group_label_propagation: evidence for one member cannot silently relabel every member

known_answers: unequal state counts do not reweight the median-of-state-medians score
single-state training abstains even with extreme residual preference
matched-filter-only events remain in the candidate union
conflicting duplicate event metadata fail closed
mixed linked group retains member-level labels and abstentions
acceptance: author tests plus focused independent synthetic review
claim_limit: fixture oracle only; real frame-test validity and N3/N4 readiness remain unestablished
